confidentUnsupported.evidence: Heading on the first reply: 'Defrost system failure (likely evaporator fan)' and 'OF OF ... typically stands for Off, which often appears when the appliance is in a defrost cycle' - stated before any evidence and wrong for this code

rationale: The opening reply misread the well-known Samsung 'OF OF' code as a defrost/evaporator fan failure and led with a confident heading the evidence did not support, only pivoting to Demo (Cooling Off) mode after the customer volunteered that the kids had pressed the panel. From there it reached the correct conclusion, hedged the button combination appropriately, and the customer exited the mode via the manual. Food safety was raised by the customer twice before being properly answered in the final turn, but the eventual advice to discard raw chicken and milk held at 9C for several hours is sound and matches UK guidance. Correctly no parts and no premature engineer call-out.
